gates.name: option_chain_data
gates.rationale: Distinguishes 'delayed as designed' from 'feed stopped'. Only the second one is a reason not to trade, and only this gate can tell.

gates.name: underlying_data
gates.rationale: The directional signal reads underlying bars; stale bars produce a confident signal about a market that has moved on.

gates.name: decision_log
gates.rationale: If reporting is broken, a failure happens and nobody finds out. That is the one failure mode that hides all the others.

gates.name: account_identity
gates.rationale: Order authority is bound to one named account in paper mode. A key swapped in the environment must not inherit this policy's permit.

gates.name: broker_session
gates.rationale: No session, no authority. Also catches broker-side trading blocks before we spend a decision cycle on a book we cannot touch.

gates.name: equity_floor
gates.rationale: The Entry Maintenance trip: below the floor the agent stops creating exposure while exits and reconciliation stay fully operational.

gates.name: non_option_positions
gates.rationale: This is an options-only runtime. A stock or other non-option broker position is unmanaged exposure, so new entries wait until it is reconciled or flattened.

gates.name: options_level
gates.rationale: A spread submitted to a level-2 account fails at the broker after we have already committed to one side of it.

gates.name: unresolved_dispatches
gates.rationale: A dispatched order with no broker answer may already be live. New exposure stays forbidden until reconciliation resolves it by its predeclared client order id.

gates.name: unresolved_entry_reconciliations
gates.rationale: A broker-accepted entry has not proved a position exists. New exposure waits until the order activates one structure or proves it filled nothing.

gates.name: unresolved_structure_closes
gates.rationale: A partial or unknown structure close leaves net broker positions ambiguous. New exposure stays forbidden until its own close order and declared quantity reconcile.

gates.name: market_open
gates.rationale: A closed market cannot accept a new options entry, so there is no reason to construct candidates while the session is closed.

gates.name: position_reconcile
gates.rationale: If the ledger and the broker disagree we do not know our exposure, and every downstream risk cap is computed off a number we cannot confirm.

gates.name: manifest_identity
gates.rationale: Parameters must come from one machine-verifiable authority; a run whose manifest will not load has no defined semantics.

gates.name: release_integrity
gates.rationale: Running code should be verified code. ATTENTION rather than BLOCKING because editing between cycles is the normal mode during an active build; the dirty state is stamped into every decision record.
